title: Bonds to 5
summary: Recall bonds to 5 including 0, reverse order, and more take-away facts.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Question 1 What do you need to add to 3 to make 5? Question 2 What do you need to add to 4 to make 5? Question 3 What do you need to add to 0 to make 5? Question 4 What do you need to add to 5 to make 5? Question 5 Ben has 5 {items} and gives away 3. How many are left? Question 6 What two numbers make 5? Question 7 What two numbers make 5? Question 8 types 3 + 2. Question 9 What is 5 take away 4? Question 10 Mia has 5 {items} and gives them all away. How many are left?
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy builds pictured bonds to 5 and introduces related subtraction. Medium mixes missing parts, zero and subtraction with picture support. Hard recalls missing parts and subtraction with numeric answers. No spelling or multi-statement checking is required.
